referenceReview.scope: V6 uses light orientation-coded review colours and explicitly labels the square post. V5 dimensions, geometry, original-reference lettering shapes and material defaults remain unchanged. Review colours are not model material defaults.

display.purpose: Documentation-only face distinction; not runtime material or lighting.

projectionRules.front: Camera at -Y looking +Y with +Z up; boards extend toward screen right.
projectionRules.right: Camera at +X looking -X with +Z up; board end faces at X=0.5025 occlude the post centrally, not beside it.
projectionRules.back: Camera at +Y looking -Y with +Z up; boards extend toward screen left; backs blank.
projectionRules.top: Camera at +Z looking -Z, +X screen right, +Y screen up. Both boards coincide into one extension. The circular finial hides the centre of the square collar, but all four collar corners remain visible.
projectionRules.collarCornerVisibility: On each collar edge, the sections where the other coordinate has magnitude greater than sqrt(0.030^2-0.026^2) remain visible beyond the finial disk. The collar hides the post top.

precedence: Select per-region material, otherwise group material, otherwise default material.
Apply per-region colour if supplied, otherwise group colour. Without a colour override, preserve the selected material colour.
appearance.letteringSurface: Each lettering region uses the original-reference-derived flat alpha mask on its own board. No separate coplanar mesh, extrusion or back text. Board material replacement preserves the independent lettering region.
appearance.booleanOwnership: Retain source-region ownership on all exposed faces during union; remove buried faces. Do not flatten region assignments into one material. At finial/collar, collar/shaft and board/shaft joins, the finial, collar and respective board own their exposed boundary faces.
appearance.instanceIsolation: Do not mutate other instances through shared material state.
appearance.geometryInvariant: Colour changes only tint; full material overrides replace surface properties within their region. Neither override may alter mesh positions, dimensions, region boundaries or transforms. No geometric displacement, baked lighting or automatic light creation.
appearance.apiStatus: Parameter requirements for future asset construction; no runtime API implemented.

referenceReview.scope: Recalibrated dimensions to the compact original v1 silhouette while preserving total height 480 mm. All five views now use the same numeric primitives and orthographic scale. Default material unchanged.
referenceReview.colourAuthority: Review colours are illustrative targets, not runtime defaults. Use appearance defaults or caller overrides.

sourceRatioEvidence.method: Dark contour spans including outline thickness. New rounded dimensions follow ratios; the original is illustrative, so exact camera recovery is not claimed.

precedence: Select per-region material, otherwise metal-group material, otherwise default material.
Apply per-region colour if supplied, otherwise metal-group colour. Without a colour override, preserve the selected material colour.
appearance.booleanOwnership: Preserve the source region on each exposed surface after union; remove buried faces. The finial owns its exposed spherical surface, the collar its exposed cylindrical band and annular shoulders, and the shaft its remaining exposed cylinder and bottom.
appearance.geometryInvariant: Colour and material replacement must not change positions, radii, heights, joins or region boundaries; no displacement, baked lighting or automatic lights.
appearance.instanceIsolation: Do not mutate shared materials on other instances.
appearance.apiStatus: Requirements for future construction parameters, not an implemented runtime API.

lettering.authority: The FRONT lettering of the original v1 reference owns glyph shapes, weight, relative spacing and case. The former hand-authored stroke glyphs are rejected and removed.
lettering.method: Sample a flat alpha mask derived from the original FRONT lettering; use the same mask on the corresponding front and oblique board face. Do not approximate using a substituted font.
lettering.cropConvention: Half-open left, top, right, bottom coordinates in the 1536 x 1024 original.
lettering.mapping: Crop each mask to the bounding rectangle of alpha >= 0.5 plus 2 source pixels of padding. Scale uniformly by 0.48/177 metres per source pixel; centre the unpadded bounds on the existing exposed-board centre. Bilinear sampling preserves edge antialiasing. No independent X/Y stretching.
lettering.notes: The source board colour, lighting, outline and background are not copied; only alpha defines the lettering shape. Apply replaceable ivory by default. Flat front paint, no extrusion or back text. Source raster limits fine-detail resolution; this is not a recovered font file.

edgeCoverage.purpose: Tighten resampled antialias coverage around the unchanged alpha=0.5 contour; avoid magnifying source-pixel blur.
